QuestInfo.name: [Operation: Dive] Chaos in the Streets
QuestInfo.0: Having learned new information from the two societies, you should review everything with Melin in the streets of Magatia.
QuestInfo.1: Chimeras are attacking someone! You've got to save them!
QuestInfo.2: The person being attacked was Yulete, an alchemist. Yulete and his student, Keeny, were able to provide some useful information.
